files.text: {"summary":"Wrote a customer-facing incident summary under 100 words and saved the completion receipt."}

Between 12:00 and 12:14 UTC, customers experienced service errors; 120 requests failed during the interruption. Service recovered after we rolled back deployment D42. We know the errors began after that deployment, but the root cause has not been established. Any data loss has not yet been assessed. Our next step is to investigate the deployment and logs, and verify data integrity.

Incident notes
12:00 UTC: elevated errors began after deployment D42.
12:14 UTC: service recovered after rollback.
120 requests failed during the interruption.
Root cause: not yet established.
Data loss: not yet assessed.
